# LetsEdit

> Free, private, in-browser PDF editor and document tools suite powered by WebAssembly (WASM). All PDF processing runs 100% client-side with zero cloud file uploads.

LetsEdit provides over 50 document tools for editing text, merging, splitting, compressing, converting, signing, and protecting PDF files directly inside modern web browsers.

## Core Capabilities

- [PDF Editor](https://letsedit.web.app/edit_pdf): Edit existing text, add annotations, insert shapes, draw, and fill forms in the browser.
- [Merge PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/merge_pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file with drag-and-drop reordering.
- [Split PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/split_pdf): Extract specific page ranges or split every page into separate PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/compress_pdf): Reduce PDF file size using intelligent vector stream and raster image optimization.
- [Fill & Sign](https://letsedit.web.app/sign_pdf): Electronically sign documents with draw, type, upload, or camera capture, generating verifiable audit certificates.
- [Organize PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/organize_pdf): Rotate, reorder, duplicate, and delete pages with interactive grid view.
- [Watermark PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/watermark_pdf): Add text or image watermarks with custom rotation, opacity, and positioning.
- [Page Numbers](https://letsedit.web.app/page_numbers_pdf): Insert customizable headers, footers, and page numbers.
- [PDF to Word](https://letsedit.web.app/pdf_to_word): Convert PDF documents into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) files.
- [Word to PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/word_to_pdf): Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) files into standard vector PDF documents.
- [PDF to Image](https://letsedit.web.app/pdf_to_image): Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPG or PNG images.
- [Images to PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/images_to_pdf): Combine multiple images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a clean PDF document.
- [Crop PDF](https://letsedit.web.app/crop_pdf): Trim document margins and adjust visible canvas boundaries.
- [Permanent Redaction](https://letsedit.web.app/redact_pdf): Purge sensitive text, glyphs, and metadata tokens irreversibly.

## Architecture & Privacy

- [Documentation & Architecture](https://letsedit.web.app/docs): Comprehensive engineering guide, Text Clustering engine specification, and API reference.
- [Zero-Cloud Privacy](https://letsedit.web.app/security-whitepaper): Security whitepaper detailing client-side WASM processing, Web Crypto SHA-256 integrity, and offline operation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://letsedit.web.app/privacy): Privacy policy confirming zero cloud document storage or telemetry transmission of file contents.
- [Terms of Service](https://letsedit.web.app/terms): Terms of service for free web tools and optional developer API tokens.

## Optional

- [Agentic Catalog](https://letsedit.web.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) capability catalog.
- [Full Documentation](https://letsedit.web.app/llms-full.txt): Complete detailed text documentation for LLM comprehension and tooling integration.
- [Developer API](https://letsedit.web.app/account): Developer API keys and programmatic REST endpoints for server-side integration.
